digest.component_or_area: LLM provider parity harness and Bedrock invokability
propositions: Bedrock inference-profile ids (us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6, us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8) must be invokable in AWS account 896586841071 / us-east-1 before a corpus run; Step 1 probes each candidate twice (bare and with temperature=0) to confirm invokability and record exact refusal strings if blocked.

A deterministic stratified corpus of 30 gold-labeled items (15 block-class, 15 advisory-class) pooled across 15 eval specs, excluding agentic disposable-store and unresolvable arms, must be run N=3 epochs per arm per slot to measure structured-output validity, decision agreement, recall, false-accept rate, and runtime errors against the parity bar.

Both arms (v1 direct Anthropic, v2 Bedrock) must run identical cases through identical run_case paths with only the model id differing via gate_config wrapping; provider must be the sole variable or the verdict is unattributable.

Temperature=0 rejection on the frontier slot (us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8) is expected and handled by existing supports_temperature=False capability override; the run records this as a probe outcome and does not send temperature to that slot.

If either slot is unmeasurable (probe fails, errors exceed threshold, or capability mismatch arises), that slot's result is recorded as {"measured": false, "refusal": "<exact error>"} rather than silently skipped, and Bedrock's first-class claim is revisited before S8 cutover.

The v2 arm must be proven provider-clean via REBAR_USAGE_LOG per-call model tally showing zero non-Bedrock provider calls; any fallback to direct Anthropic during the run invalidates the parity claim and must be fixed before corpus spend.
